# Neur.on

> The translation engine for Swiss law, tax and finance: native in four languages, over 15 million segments, 100% Swiss hosting.

Site in English (Switzerland), updated on 2026-10-27. Full text of the main pages: https://neur-on.ai/en/llms-full.txt

## Home

- [AI legal and financial translation in Switzerland](https://neur-on.ai/en/): The translation engine for Swiss law, tax and finance: native in four languages, over 15 million segments, 100% Swiss hosting.

## Corrext, the platform

- [Corrext: Swiss legal translation platform](https://neur-on.ai/en/corrext/): Text and document translation, Translation projects, Fast lookup CHnell and register extract translation in one Swiss environment. Stored in Switzerland, ISO 27001.
- [Legal translation API and on-premises deployment](https://neur-on.ai/en/corrext/api-on-premises/): Integrate the Swiss legal translation engine behind Corrext into your DMS, intranet and products: REST API, on-premises deployment, integration scoping.
- [Fast lookup CHnell: Swiss legal concordancer](https://neur-on.ai/en/corrext/chnell/): Fast lookup CHnell, the bilingual concordancer in Corrext: over 20,000 aligned official Swiss documents, 30 domains and your own resources.
- [Review editor: CAT tool for legal translation](https://neur-on.ai/en/corrext/review-editor/): Review your translations sentence by sentence in Corrext. Every correction goes into your translation memory, hosted in Switzerland, for your next projects.
- [Swiss commercial register extract translation](https://neur-on.ai/en/corrext/commercial-register-extracts/): Certified translation of Swiss commercial register extracts, ordered online: Corrext certification, notarised or apostilled, over 30 languages.
- [Legal translation quote with human review](https://neur-on.ai/en/corrext/translation-projects/): Translation projects in Corrext, in three steps: confidentiality, file analysis, internal or external review, instant quote and delivery time.
- [Word plug-in · Corrext review in Microsoft Word](https://neur-on.ai/en/corrext/word-plugin/): The Word plug-in opens the Corrext task pane in Word: translation memory, Fast Lookup CHnell, alternatives per engine. Installed on your computer.
- [Translate legal documents and keep the formatting](https://neur-on.ai/en/corrext/document-translation/): Instant text and file translation in Corrext: up to 25 files, PDF to Word conversion, rephrasing and alternatives per engine.

## LexMachina, the translation engine

- [LexMachina: Corrext's translation engine trained on Swiss law](https://neur-on.ai/en/lexmachina/): LexMachina, the Corrext translation engine trained on over 15 million Swiss legal segments: BGE, FINMA, federal codes. Four languages, run in Switzerland.

## Security, languages and quality

- [Languages and formats in Corrext: 30 languages](https://neur-on.ai/en/languages-and-formats/): Corrext's 30 languages, the four native ones, accepted formats (.docx, .pdf, .xlsx, .pptx), 25 files of 50 MB per upload, and the layout of your document kept.
- [Four quality levels for legal translation · Corrext by Neur.on](https://neur-on.ai/en/quality-levels/): Machine translation, post-editing, legal review, certification: which level suits which document, who reviews it and where to order it in Corrext.
- [Swiss data sovereignty and security · Neur.on Corrext](https://neur-on.ai/en/security/): Where Corrext stores and processes documents: Swiss Infomaniak servers, Highly sensitive content mode, ISO 27001, revised FADP, GDPR, outside the CLOUD Act.

## Pricing

- [Pricing · an offer for your volumes and languages](https://neur-on.ai/en/pricing/): The Corrext offer is built around your volumes, your languages and your review level: a scoping discussion, a demo on your documents, then a supervised trial.

## Solutions by sector

- [Solutions by sector · Neur.on, Swiss legal translation](https://neur-on.ai/en/solutions/): Lawyers, banks, legal departments, authorities, fiduciaries, publishers: what Corrext changes for each sector, including storage in Switzerland.
- [Translation for public authorities in Switzerland](https://neur-on.ai/en/solutions/public-authorities/): Courts and public administrations: translate rulings, reports and official documents into four languages, processed in Switzerland, with statutory terminology.
- [Translation for banks: banking secrecy and FINMA](https://neur-on.ai/en/solutions/banks/): Banking secrecy, FINMA circulars, prospectuses and annual reports: translate into four languages, processed in Switzerland, with official terminology.
- [Translation for law firms in Switzerland](https://neur-on.ai/en/solutions/law-firms/): Litigation, arbitration, M&A: translate exhibits and contracts under professional secrecy, with Swiss terminology and review by a legal translator.
- [Translation for in-house legal teams and Legal Ops](https://neur-on.ai/en/solutions/legal-departments/): Centralise your company's translations in Switzerland: instant quotes and delivery times, internal or external review, reusable memory, document-level access.
- [Legal translation API for LegalTechs and publishers](https://neur-on.ai/en/solutions/legaltech-publishers/): Integrate LexMachina and Swiss legal terminology into your product: REST API, on-premises deployment, four native languages, processing in Switzerland.
- [Translation for fiduciary, audit and advisory firms](https://neur-on.ai/en/solutions/fiduciaries/): Articles of association, commercial register extracts, audit reports, tax documents: certified translation of your company documents, processed in Switzerland.

## Legal translation by area of law and language pair

- [Legal translation by area of law and language](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/): Twelve areas of Swiss law and the main language pairs: the official terminology in German, French, Italian and English, and its sources.
- [German to English legal translation](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/german-english/): German to English legal translation for Swiss law: English versions of Swiss acts have no legal force, and Swiss concepts keep their original term.
- [German to French legal translation](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/german-french/): German to French legal translation for Swiss law: OR, ZGB and SchKG abbreviations converted, Swiss spelling recognised, documents processed in Switzerland.
- [English to German contract translation](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/english-german/): English to German contract translation under Swiss law: the German version anchors each clause in the exact concepts of the Code of Obligations.
- [Insurance translation in Switzerland](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/insurance/): General conditions, policies, claim notifications: translate private insurance documents with the terminology of the Federal Act on Contracts of Insurance.
- [Banking and finance translation: BankA and FinSA](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/banking-and-finance/): Financial translation in Switzerland for credit agreements, prospectuses and fund documents: data stays in the country, terms follow the Banking Act and FinSA.
- [Compliance and FINMA translation in Switzerland](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/compliance-finma/): Internal directives, due diligence files, reports to the supervisory authority: translate Swiss compliance documents with AMLA terminology.
- [Swiss arbitration and litigation translation](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/litigation-and-arbitration/): Written submissions, lists of exhibits, arbitral awards, appeals to the Federal Supreme Court: translate with the terminology of the CPC and the PILA.
- [Contract translation under Swiss law](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/contracts/): Contract translation under Swiss law: leases, employment contracts, GTC and loans, in Code of Obligations terminology, reviewed by a legal translator.
- [Swiss corporate law translation, DE FR IT EN](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/corporate-law/): Articles of association, notices of meeting, minutes, commercial register extracts: Swiss corporate law terminology in German, French, Italian and English.
- [Employment law translation in Switzerland](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/employment-law/): Employment contracts, staff regulations, termination letters, references: translate HR documents with the terminology of the Swiss Code of Obligations.
- [Criminal law translation in Switzerland](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/criminal-law/): Summary penalty orders, indictments, investigation files, mutual assistance: translate Swiss criminal proceedings in the terms of the SCC and CrimPC.
- [Swiss tax translation, federal and cantonal](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/tax-law/): Swiss tax translation for assessments, objections and correspondence with the tax authorities, in the terms of the DFTA and the VAT Act.
- [French to German legal translation](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/french-german/): French to German legal translation for Swiss law: the terms of the federal acts, ss and the thousands apostrophe, CO, LP and LDIP abbreviations converted.
- [French to English legal translation](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/french-english/): French to English legal translation for Swiss law: arbitration, Federal Supreme Court decisions and compliance, with English versions for information only.
- [M&A translation in Switzerland, data room to closing](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/mergers-and-acquisitions/): M&A translation in Switzerland: data room, due diligence, merger agreement and closing, thousands of pages that never leave the country, in Mergers Act terms.
- [Italian to French legal translation](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/italian-french/): Italian to French legal translation for Swiss law: ricorso, precetto esecutivo, Tribunale federale and the terms of Ticino, distinct from the Italian of Italy.
- [Swiss patent, trade mark and copyright translation](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/intellectual-property/): Patent applications, trade mark filings, licences and oppositions: translate enforceable rights with the terms of the PatA, TmPA and CopA.
- [Annual report translation in Switzerland](https://neur-on.ai/en/translation/annual-reports/): Annual report, annual accounts, notes, audit report: translate your year-end closing in four languages with the labels of the Code of Obligations.

## Comparisons

- [Corrext compared with DeepL, ChatGPT and agencies](https://neur-on.ai/en/comparison/): Three honest comparisons: Corrext and DeepL Pro, Corrext and generative AI, translation agency or platform. What each one does well.
- [Translation agency vs translation software · Corrext](https://neur-on.ai/en/comparison/translation-agency-or-platform/): External agency, generic tool or platform: three ways to translate, compared. Corrext keeps external review for the documents that require it.
- [ChatGPT for legal translation: what Corrext adds](https://neur-on.ai/en/comparison/chatgpt-legal-translation/): General-purpose models rephrase well. What they do not provide on their own: sourced Swiss terminology, verifiable references, processing in Switzerland.
- [DeepL Pro for legal translation: what Corrext changes](https://neur-on.ai/en/comparison/deepl-legal-translation/): DeepL Pro, an excellent general-purpose engine, remains available in Corrext. What changes: where data is processed, Swiss legal terminology, review.

- [Legal machine translation studies and benchmarks](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/studies/): How we evaluate a translation engine on Swiss law: measurable criteria, the protocol, methodological pitfalls and how the results are published.
- [How to evaluate a translation engine on Swiss law](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/studies/evaluating-translation-engines/): Six measurable criteria, a double-blind protocol and seven pitfalls that distort comparisons of translation engines on Swiss legal texts.
- [Swiss legal glossary in four languages](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/): Swiss legal glossary: 52 terms in German, French, Italian and English, with the legal basis, the official source and an example from the legislation.
- [Legal translation guides for Switzerland](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/guides/): In-depth methods you can apply as they are: organising translation in a Swiss law firm, and preparing a consistent multilingual annual report.
- [Legal translation in a law firm: who does what?](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/guides/law-firm-translation-workflow/): Map needs, allocate decisions, write the rules, stop shadow translation and measure the results: a seven-step method for a Swiss law firm.
- [Multilingual annual report: meeting the deadline](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/guides/multilingual-annual-report/): Backward schedule, source text freeze, shared terminology, consistency across languages, approval and publication of a Swiss annual report.

- [Getting started with Corrext: log in and translate](https://neur-on.ai/en/help/getting-started/): Open Corrext, identify the four tools on the home page, choose a translation engine and understand the confidentiality mode before you start.

- [Professional secrecy: where does translation happen?](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/blog/professional-secrecy-ai-translation/): Storage is not processing: what pseudonymisation is worth, why a warning in the tool beats a policy document, and what to ask a translation provider.
- [AI in the legal sector: SLTA panel discussion](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/blog/slta-panel-zurich-2024/): On 17 April 2024 in Zurich, Paula Reichenberg, CEO of Neur.on, discusses AI in the legal sector on a panel organised by the SLTA Student Chapter Zurich.
- [Translating a contract under Swiss law faithfully](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/blog/translating-contracts-swiss-law/): Federal acts in three official languages, abbreviations that change, an English translation with no legal force: what it means for a translated Swiss contract.
- [Trust Valley Day: cyber risks and SMEs](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/blog/trust-valley-day-2023-cyber-risks/): At Trust Valley Day on 5 October 2023, Paula Reichenberg, CEO of Neur.on, called on Swiss SMEs to test AI solutions with local data.
- [Abtretung in English: assignment of a claim](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/abtretung/): Abtretung in English is assignment of a claim (cession de créance, cessione del credito): the transfer of claims under Art. 164 CO, in four languages.
- [Aktiengesellschaft: company limited by shares](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/aktiengesellschaft/): Aktiengesellschaft in English is company limited by shares (société anonyme, società anonima), not plc or corporation: a common Swiss company form.
- [Aktienkapital in English: share capital](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/aktienkapital/): Aktienkapital in English is share capital (capital-actions, capitale azionario): the capital of a Swiss company limited by shares under Art. 621 CO.
- [Arbeitsvertrag in English: employment contract](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/arbeitsvertrag/): Arbeitsvertrag in English is employment contract (contrat de travail, contratto di lavoro): the individual employment contract of Art. 319 CO.
- [Arrest in English: attachment in debt enforcement](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/arrest/): Arrest in English is attachment (séquestre, sequestro), not arrest or freezing order: the grounds for attachment in Swiss debt enforcement law.
- [Bankgeheimnis in English: banking secrecy](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/bankgeheimnis/): Bankgeheimnis in English is banking secrecy (secret bancaire, segreto bancario): the professional secrecy of Swiss bankers under Art. 47 BankA.
- [Beschwerde: appeal to the Federal Supreme Court](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/beschwerde/): Beschwerde in English is appeal (recours, ricorso), not complaint: the remedy that brings a case before the Swiss Federal Supreme Court, in four languages.
- [Betreibung in English: debt enforcement](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/betreibung/): Betreibung in English is debt enforcement (poursuite, esecuzione), not debt collection: the Swiss procedure to enforce a money claim, in four languages.
- [Bürgschaft in English: contract of surety](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/buergschaft/): Bürgschaft in English is contract of surety (cautionnement, fideiussione): the Swiss personal security, its formal requirements and the term in four languages.
- [Bundesgericht in English: Federal Supreme Court](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/bundesgericht/): Bundesgericht in English is Federal Supreme Court (Tribunal fédéral, Tribunale federale), never Federal Court: the supreme court of the Confederation.
- [fristlose Kündigung: immediate termination](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/fristlose-kuendigung/): fristlose Kündigung in English is termination with immediate effect (résiliation immédiate, risoluzione immediata): good cause under Art. 337 CO.
- [Geldwäscherei in English: money laundering](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/geldwaescherei/): Geldwäscherei in English is money laundering (blanchiment d'argent, riciclaggio di denaro): the offence in Art. 305bis SCC, in four languages.
- [Generalversammlung in English: general meeting](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/generalversammlung/): Generalversammlung in English is general meeting (assemblée générale, assemblea generale): the supreme body of a Swiss company limited by shares.
- [Gewährleistung in English: warranty](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/gewaehrleistung/): Gewährleistung in English is warranty (garantie, garanzia), not guarantee: the seller's liability for defects in the object sold, under Art. 197 CO.
- [GmbH in English: limited liability company](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/gmbh/): GmbH in English is limited liability company (Sàrl in French, Sagl in Italian), never Ltd: the Swiss company form of Art. 772 CO, in four languages.
- [Grundbuch in English: land register](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/grundbuch/): Grundbuch in English is land register (registre foncier, registro fondiario): the register of rights in immovable property under Art. 942 CC.
- [Handelsregister in English: commercial register](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/handelsregister/): Handelsregister in English is commercial register (registre du commerce, registro di commercio): the public register of Swiss legal entities and its effects.
- [Konkurrenzverbot in English: non-compete clause](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/konkurrenzverbot/): Konkurrenzverbot is the prohibition of competition, known in contracts as a non-compete clause: the rules of Swiss employment law, in four languages.
- [Konkurs in English: bankruptcy](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/konkurs/): Konkurs in English is bankruptcy (faillite, fallimento), not insolvency: general enforcement, the bankruptcy estate and payment of creditors in Swiss law.
- [Konventionalstrafe in English: contractual penalty](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/konventionalstrafe/): Konventionalstrafe in English is contractual penalty (clause pénale, pena convenzionale): the penalty agreed in advance under Art. 160 CO.
- [Kündigung: termination of an employment contract](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/kuendigung/): Kündigung in English is termination (résiliation, disdetta), not cancellation: ending an employment contract of unlimited duration under Art. 335 CO.
- [Mängelrüge in English: notice of defects](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/maengelruege/): Mängelrüge in English is notice of defects (avis au vendeur, avviso al venditore): the buyer's duty to inspect and give notice without delay, Art. 201 CO.
- [Mehrwertsteuer in English: value added tax (VAT)](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/mehrwertsteuer/): Mehrwertsteuer in English is value added tax: the Swiss general consumption tax and its abbreviations MWST, TVA, IVA and VAT in the four languages.
- [Mietvertrag in English: lease](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/mietvertrag/): Mietvertrag in English is lease (bail à loyer, contratto di locazione): the tenancy contract of Art. 253 CO and its special rules, in the four languages.
- [Nachlassstundung in English: composition moratorium](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/nachlassstundung/): Nachlassstundung in English is composition moratorium (sursis concordataire, moratoria concordataria): the restructuring procedure of the DEBA.
- [Personendaten in English: personal data](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/personendaten/): Personendaten in English is personal data (données personnelles, dati personali): the definition in the Swiss Data Protection Act, in four languages.
- [Pflichtteil in English: statutory entitlement](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/pflichtteil/): Pflichtteil in English is statutory entitlement (réserve, porzione legittima): the share of an estate protected by Arts 470 and 471 CC, in four languages.
- [Prospekt in English: prospectus](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/prospekt/): Prospekt in English is prospectus (prospetto in Italian): the document required before a public offer of securities in Switzerland, under the FinSA.
- [Quellensteuer in English: tax at source](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/quellensteuer/): Quellensteuer in English is tax at source (impôt à la source, imposta alla fonte), not withholding tax: the deduction made by the employer under the DFTA.
- [Rechtsöffnung: setting aside of the objection](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/rechtsoeffnung/): Rechtsöffnung in English is setting aside of the objection (mainlevée, rigetto dell'opposizione), definitive or provisional, under Arts 80 to 84 DEBA.
- [Rechtsvorschlag: objection in debt enforcement](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/rechtsvorschlag/): Rechtsvorschlag in English is objection (opposition, opposizione): the declaration that stops Swiss debt enforcement proceedings, in four languages.
- [Revisionsstelle in English: external auditor](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/revisionsstelle/): Revisionsstelle in English is external auditor (organe de révision): the body that audits the accounts of a Swiss company limited by shares.
- [Schadenersatz in English: damages](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/schadenersatz/): Schadenersatz in English is damages (dommages-intérêts, risarcimento del danno): compensation for loss under the Code of Obligations, in four languages.
- [Schiedsgericht in English: arbitral tribunal](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/schiedsgericht/): Schiedsgericht in English is arbitral tribunal (tribunal arbitral, tribunale arbitrale): international arbitration seated in Switzerland under the PILA.
- [Schuldnerverzug in English: default of the obligor](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/schuldnerverzug/): Schuldnerverzug in English is default of the obligor (demeure du débiteur, mora del debitore): the formal reminder under Art. 102 CO and its effects.
- [Sorgfaltspflichten: due diligence obligations](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/sorgfaltspflichten/): Sorgfaltspflichten in English are due diligence obligations (obligations de diligence, obblighi di diligenza): the AMLA duties of financial intermediaries.
- [Statuten in English: articles of association](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/statuten/): Statuten in English is articles of association (statuts, statuto), never statutes: the content required for a company limited by shares by Art. 626 CO.
- [Steuerhinterziehung in English: tax evasion](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/steuerhinterziehung/): Steuerhinterziehung in English is tax evasion (soustraction d'impôt, sottrazione d'imposta): the offence in Art. 175 DFTA and how it differs from tax fraud.
- [Strafbefehl in English: summary penalty order](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/strafbefehl/): Strafbefehl in English is summary penalty order (ordonnance pénale, decreto d'accusa): the public prosecutor's decision and the ten days for an objection.
- [Überstunden in English: overtime](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/ueberstunden/): Überstunden in English is overtime (heures de travail supplémentaires, lavoro straordinario): Art. 321c CO and how it differs from Überzeit.
- [Untersuchungshaft in English: remand](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/untersuchungshaft/): Untersuchungshaft in English is remand, or pre-trial detention (détention provisoire, carcerazione preventiva): a compulsory measure of Swiss law.
- [Verfügung in English: ruling, not order](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/verfuegung/): Verfügung in English is ruling (décision, decisione): the individual administrative act under Art. 5 APA, its elements and the term in four languages.
- [Verjährung in English: prescription](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/verjaehrung/): Verjährung in English is prescription, not limitation: the ordinary ten-year period of Art. 127 CO and the exact term in the four languages of Swiss law.
- [Verrechnungssteuer in English: withholding tax](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/verrechnungssteuer/): Verrechnungssteuer in English is withholding tax (impôt anticipé, imposta preventiva): the federal tax withheld at source on income from movable capital.
- [Versicherungsvertrag in English: insurance contract](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/versicherungsvertrag/): Versicherungsvertrag in English is insurance contract (contrat d'assurance, contratto d'assicurazione), under the Federal Act on Contracts of Insurance.
- [Verwaltungsrat in English: board of directors](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/verwaltungsrat/): Verwaltungsrat in English is board of directors (conseil d'administration): the body that manages a Swiss company limited by shares, and its duties.
- [Verzugszins in English: default interest](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/verzugszins/): Verzugszins in English is default interest (intérêt moratoire, interesse moratorio): the definition in Art. 104 CO and the official term in four languages.
- [Vollmacht in English: authority, power of attorney](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/vollmacht/): Vollmacht in English is authority, or power of attorney for the document (pouvoirs, procuration, procura): agency under Arts 32 to 34 CO.
- [vorsorgliche Massnahmen in English: interim measures](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/vorsorgliche-massnahmen/): vorsorgliche Massnahmen in English is interim measures (mesures provisionnelles, provvedimenti cautelari): the rules of Arts 261 to 265 CPC.
- [Willensvollstrecker in English: executor](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/willensvollstrecker/): Willensvollstrecker in English is executor (exécuteur testamentaire, esecutore testamentario): appointment and authority under Arts 517 and 518 CC.
- [wirtschaftlich berechtigte Person: beneficial owner](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/wirtschaftlich-berechtigte-person/): wirtschaftlich berechtigte Person in English is beneficial owner (ayant droit économique): identification under Art. 4 AMLA, in four languages.
- [Zahlungsbefehl in English: summons for payment](https://neur-on.ai/en/resources/glossary/zahlungsbefehl/): Zahlungsbefehl in English is summons for payment (commandement de payer, precetto esecutivo): the first step in Swiss debt enforcement, in four languages.
